output.reason: The release note [ev-d38f50d1a274] gives only a one-line summary, but the linked PR [ev-0cc0faa2e3b0] fills in the rest. The subject is the `crossplane beta validate` CLI command's inputs for resources and extensions. The change is added support for parsing and loading lists of them, done through a new MultiLoader that merges what other loaders return. The PR also says the new loader only runs when an input contains commas, so existing usage should be barely affected. That is enough to write the assertion: users of the beta validate CLI can now pass comma-separated lists, and anyone who does nothing sees no change. The changed files [ev-383d7a06f432] are all under cmd/crank/beta/validate, which confirms the change touches only the CLI.
